searchText: Where can I get the specs for the evm? The formal spec is https://github.com/ethereum/yellowpaper It doesn't cover everything you need to know in practice, though, and if you aren't mathematically inclined it may not be the most useful form of spec. Thanks I'll note that This seemed useful https://jellopaper.org/index.html This companion tutorial may be helpful as well. https://ethereum.org/en/developers/tutorials/yellow-paper-evm/
